war_type.label: War Type
war_type.description: The type/size of the war, which determines war goal slots and infamy

primary_aggressor.label: Primary Aggressor
primary_aggressor.description: The nation ID of the primary attacking nation

primary_defender.label: Primary Defender
primary_defender.description: The nation ID of the primary defending nation

session_declared.label: Session Declared
session_declared.description: The session this war was declared in

session_ended.label: Session Ended
session_ended.description: The session this war was archived/ended in. None means the war is still ongoing.

victor.label: Victor
victor.description: Which side won the war, set when the war is archived

war_goals.label: War Goals
war_goals.description: The declared war goals for this conflict

participants.label: Participants
participants.description: The Nations and Mercenary companies involved in the war
